facts.label: Going to e will
facts.sub: Use am/is/are going to para planos: I’m going to read it. Use will (’ll) para ofertas e previsões: I’ll bring it back. I think it’ll be exciting.

facts.label: Planos
facts.sub: Para planos, use am/is/are going to + verbo: I’m going to read it on Saturday. Pergunte What are you going to read? Responda com o título ou o tipo do livro.

facts.label: Ofertas
facts.sub: Para ofertas e promessas na hora, use will: I’ll scan the book. I’ll bring it back on time. Na fala, will vira ’ll e depois dele vem o verbo base.

pages.title: A city library · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Friday afternoon in the city library in Halifax. Tall shelves are full of books. Clara walks to the front desk. Her friend Paul is the librarian. He sits behind a big computer. He looks up and smiles.

items.why: Com she, o verbo leva -s: scans.
Com we, a forma base: bring.

solo: Aluno responde; você explica o porquê.
group: Cada aluno responde antes de ver a correção.
Explique o “por quê” de cada resposta em uma frase.
extra90: Peça que digam a resposta em voz alta com a frase inteira.
answers: Yesterday I ___. → borrowed
She ___ every day. → scans
He is ___ now. → keeping
We ___ every day. → bring
